description: Redux reducer module for managing channel categories state in Mattermost, including handling received categories, deletions, channel leaves, team leaves, and category order per team.

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Reducer function managing channel categories by their ID, handling actions like receiving categories, deleting, leaving channels, and team removal.

methods.description: Reducer function managing the order of channel categories per team, handling actions like receiving category order, deleting categories, and leaving teams.
